- [Should borrowers float or fix?](https://craigsip.com/news/should-borrowers-float-or-fix)  
  - Markdown: https://craigsip.com/ai-reference/should-borrowers-float-or-fix.md  
  - Published: 2023-10-18  
  - Excerpt: Choosing a floating or fixed mortgage depends on interest rate trends, budget flexibility, and risk tolerance. Shorter terms provide flexibility, while longer fixes lock in stability during uncertain markets.
